widget.name: Ax Capture
widget.description: Captures a named page element as a PNG image or PDF file and downloads it, using html2canvas-pro.

property.caption: Target element name
property.description: The "Name" (Common tab, in Studio Pro) of the element to capture. The widget locates it on the page via its "mx-name-<name>" CSS class.

property.caption: File name
property.description: Base name of the downloaded file, without extension. The actual file is saved as "{fileName}_yyyy-MM-dd_{timestamp}.png/pdf".

property.caption: Format
property.description: Output format for the captured file.

property.caption: Show button
property.description: Show the built-in capture button. When off, the button stays in the page but is visually hidden, so it can still be triggered programmatically (for example from a custom JS action).

property.caption: Button caption
property.description: Text shown on the capture button.
